_comment: Some New Relic AWS Metric Streams names carry a suffix that depends on the metric's CloudWatch dimension set (and varies by service). Keyed by namespace, then by the sorted, comma-joined dimension names. Only CONFIRMED entries belong here. Confirmed 2026-10-03 on real data: AWS/Lambda metrics with only the FunctionName dimension are named aws.lambda.<Metric>.byFunction (the plain aws.lambda.<Metric> is the account-wide metric). NOT yet confirmed: other Lambda dimension sets (the names .byFunctionAlias, .byRegion exist but their dimension sets were not checked) and every other service. Check with: SELECT uniques(metricName) FROM Metric WHERE aws.Namespace = '<namespace>'
